C.errors: Notes state he demands five size-6 screws/bolts in r17, but he actually wants five 10 mm wrenches within reach whenever he encounters a size-6 bolt.

D.errors: Wrong speakers for r13 and r15 (attributed to interviewer instead of passerby). Claims not to know what PINÁK means. Misinterprets the mechanic punchline as an unreal bolt fantasy.

F.errors: Summary and notes misread 'tizes villáskulccsal' as '10-packs of forks' and invents an intentional pun between 'villa' (mansion) and 'villáskulcs'.

json.notes: B and E are both exceptional and correctly identify the core mechanic joke: an M6 bolt ('hatos csavar') takes a 10 mm open-end wrench ('tizes villáskulcs'), the exact tool notorious worldwide for always being lost. B has slightly richer linguistic detail and panel-by-panel breakdown.
